key.name: scale
key.description: Integer scale factor. Available: 2, 3, 4, 6 (nearest is used).

key.name: corner
key.description: Corner of the primary monitor's work area where the cat sits.

key.name: position-x
key.description: Screen X coordinate. -1 means use corner placement.

key.name: position-y
key.description: Screen Y coordinate. -1 means use corner placement.

key.name: fade-on-hover
key.summary: Fade when the pointer is over the cat
key.description: The cat is always click-through; fading just keeps it from hiding content.

key.name: idle-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of inactivity before the first message

key.name: message-repeat-minutes
key.summary: Minutes between messages while you stay idle

key.name: sleep-enabled
key.summary: Let the cat fall asleep when idle for a long time

key.name: sleep-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of inactivity before the cat falls asleep

key.name: sleep-seconds
key.summary: Seconds of inactivity before the cat falls asleep
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before falling asleep. Lower values (5-15s) are great for testing.

key.name: yawn-enabled
key.description: Plays yawning animations before falling asleep.

key.name: yawn-interval-seconds
key.description: Time between consecutive yawns while drowsy.

key.name: yawn-count
key.summary: Number of yawns before deep sleep
key.description: How many times the cat yawns before falling into deep sleep.

key.name: hunger-enabled
key.description: When hungry, the cat displays an angry face until fed with a treat.

key.name: hunger-minutes
key.summary: Minutes before the cat gets hungry
key.description: How many minutes after starting or feeding before the cat gets hungry again.

key.name: hunger-seconds
key.summary: Seconds before the cat gets hungry
key.description: How many seconds after starting or feeding before the cat gets hungry again. Set to 5-15s for quick testing.

key.name: test-action
key.description: Transient action triggered from settings window (e.g. yawn, hunger, sleep, wake).

key.name: messages
key.default: ["...still here.", "Water break?", "Stretch your back.", "Eyes need rest too.", "Meow.", "Take your time.", "Long session. You okay?", "I'll keep watch."]
key.description: One is picked at random (never the same twice in a row). Keep them short.
